subject: 38 Pearl Street Preservation and Shiloh Church Easement
overview: The commission determined 38 Pearl Street to be preferably preserved and discussed holding a preservation restriction for Shiloh Baptist Church. The commission also denied significance for one property, funded historical surveys for two others, and received updates on several ongoing preservation projects.

items.title: 38 Pearl Street Significance
items.summary: Determined the property to be significant because it is a well-preserved Greek Revival structure eligible for the National Register.

items.title: 68-70 Bilodeau Road Significance
items.summary: Found the property not significant as it is a common two-family structure that has been stripped of its original architectural character.

items.title: 18 Wedgmere Road Hearing
items.summary: Tabled the hearing because the applicant failed to post the required site sign or pay for the legal advertisement.

items.title: 38 Pearl Street Preservation Hearing
items.summary: Found the property preferably preserved and referred the proposed design for a rear addition to a subcommittee for review.

items.title: Fire Department Safety Complex Documentation
items.summary: Requested that the city document the 1960s modernist safety complex prior to its demolition and replacement.

items.title: Survey Funding for 400 Mystic Avenue and 179 Main Street
items.summary: Approved $1,000 to survey the former Ballaroo skating rink site and $500 for a historical form for 179 Main Street.

items.title: National Register Updates
items.summary: Reported that Shiloh Baptist Church was determined National Register eligible by the state, while the Oak Grove service buildings were not.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Preservation Restriction
items.summary: Discussed a proposed preservation restriction required for Community Preservation Act funding and deferred action until the commission can review the responsibilities of easement holders.

items.title: Ongoing Project and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Heard updates regarding the withdrawal of a 40B project at 280 Mystic Avenue, progress on cemetery headstone repairs, and the appointment of a new president at the Brooks Estate.
